verdict.rationale: The only first-party management API in the evidence that touches pipeline configuration is the Warehouse Sync API, which configures warehouse-to-mParticle ingestion, roughly a source-side pipeline. Destination and audience-output connections are documented only as UI flows ("Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory"), the Events API is for data ingestion rather than pipeline management, and nothing describes an MCP server. missing for 10: documented API for creating inputs/sources generally, API for creating destinations/outputs, API for wiring connections between sources and destinations, API for inspecting delivery status/logs, an MCP server, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping
